verdict.rationale: Logseq's own docs describe a plugin dashboard where third-party plugins from the Marketplace can be searched, installed, updated and removed. Themes ship as plugins, unpacked plugins can be loaded from outside the marketplace, and a plugin API exists for extending the app. missing for 10: evidence of the catalog's size (the 'large' part of the story), independent or hands-on corroboration of the marketplace experience.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can browse and install from a large catalog of community plugins/extensions to add features the core app doesn't ship

citations.quote: From this dashboard, third-party plugins from the [[Marketplace]], can be searched, installed, updated and removed.
Extends the functionality of logseq with third party tools
Themes are distributed as plugins and are a type of plugin.
Click on `Load unpacked plugin` to load plugins that are distributed outside the marketplace.
